name: Zangetsu Stremio Bridge
description: Connect user-configured Stremio metadata and streaming add-ons to Zangetsu.

settings.title: Metadata Add-on Manifest URLs
settings.label: Metadata add-ons
settings.description: Add Stremio add-ons that provide catalogs and searchable metadata. Paste manifest.json URLs, separated by commas or new lines. No TMDB API key is required by this bridge.

settings.title: Stream Add-on Manifest URLs
settings.label: Stream add-ons
settings.description: Add Stremio add-ons that provide playable streams. A combined add-on can be entered in both fields.

settings.title: Maximum streams per add-on
settings.label: Maximum streams per add-on
settings.description: Limit the number of streams read from each configured add-on.

settings.title: Include torrent-only results
settings.label: Include torrent-only results
settings.description: Keep results that contain an infoHash but no direct HTTP stream URL.
